profile.headline: Software Developer at Cheney Brothers, Inc.
profile.summary: Data and systems specialist with experience in business intelligence, reporting, and data integration. Skilled in SQL Server (SSRS, SSIS, SSAS), Power BI, MySQL, Talend, and JasperReports. Worked across higher education and finance, supporting ERP systems like PeopleSoft and PROSam. Built ETL pipelines, automated workflows with Ctrl-M and batch scripting and used SSMS and Visual Studio to support development and database operations. Comfortable working across both Microsoft and open-source stacks including C#, .NET, PHP, and Linux.

positions.title: Director of Systems for Financial Aid
positions.description:
• Created and maintained SSRS reports, SSIS packages, and SSAS dashboards to support financial aid operations and reconciliation workflows.

• Implemented and maintained packaging logic, budgeting rules, and document tracking within PROSam, a core financial aid ERP platform.

• Automated and monitored critical jobs using Ctrl-M and batch scripting.

• Created Power BI reports and dashboards to expand visibility into student financial systems.
positions.insights: Query Optimization, Microsoft SQL Server and +11 skills

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst
positions.description:
• Developed reports and dashboards using SSRS and SSAS to support student information systems and institutional data needs.

• Built SSIS packages to migrate data from SQL Server to Oracle, supporting enterprise system integration with PeopleSoft.

• Executed ETL workflows to ensure accurate data transfer and minimal disruption during system transitions.
positions.insights: Query Optimization, Microsoft SQL Server and +10 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Generated automated reports from hedge fund systems to support financial analysis and client reporting.

• Built ETL workflows in Talend Open Studio and exported data to JasperReports for clear, accessible reporting.

• Maintained and queried SQL Server and MySQL databases to support accurate reporting and system performance.
positions.insights: Query Optimization, Microsoft SQL Server and +7 skills

positions.title: Technical Trainer
positions.description:
• Worked at the National Center for Improvement and Training in Computer Science (CENSAI), now known as the Center for Training in Informatics (CFRI) under Desoft.

• Taught official Microsoft SQL Server courses (2071, 2072, 2073, 2779, 2780, 2793A) and Windows Server/XP courses (2274, 2275, 2276, 2277, 2285), covering database, system, and network administration.

• Delivered training on Microsoft technologies built on the .NET Framework (ASP.NET, Visual Basic .NET, C#, SQL Server, Windows Server, IIS) and open-source tools (PHP, MySQL, Apache, Linux, REST APIs).

educations.schoolName: Vocational High School Institute of Exact Sciences Vladimir Ilich Lenin
